title: The Maharashtra Devdasi System (Abolition) Act, 2005.
full_text: The Maharashtra Devdasi System (Abolition) Act, 2005. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200633 Act Number: 33 Enactment Date: 2006-08-11 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The Maharashtra Devdasi System (Abolition) Act, 2005. Long Title: An Act to provide for a comprehensive law to abolish the practice of dedication of women as Devdasis to Hindu deities, idols, objects of worship, temples or religious institutions, and to protect the women so dedicated against exploitation, and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
